text:
leah: Heads-up — ACME POC blocked: SCIM sync returns 403 when provisioning users into Dedicated tenant; they want it resolved before EOW.

tom: Paste the SCIM error? 403 usually missing scope or expired token.

leah: From their logs: `HTTP 403 Forbidden {"detail":"service account lacks scim:write scope"}`. They used the token we generated via sales portal.

maya: Quick checklist: 1) SCIM-enabled service account for Dedicated vs Hosted? 2) Token scoped for `scim:write` and `scim:read`? 3) Private/VPC: is SCIM endpoint routable from IdP?

leah: Token created from "POC - AcmeCorp" in console (team:dedicated). Thought portal auto-adds scim scopes.

tom: It normally does, but older Dedicated snapshots may not have new role mapping. @maya check tenant service account config.

maya: Checked — account exists but scope only `users:manage` (legacy). Can patch but need token binding PR to update existing tokens.

onboarding-bot: Provisioning ticket created — POC-2293. Assigned to maya and tom. ETA 4h.

leah: Also seeing intermittent SAML login failures: `NameID format mismatch` during SSO handshake. Could be separate but same timeframe.

sam: For NameID mismatch, ask IdP to set NameID to `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` and map `email` claim. Request SAMLResponse trace.

tom: Two actions: maya fixes SCIM scopes; sam validates SAML NameID mapping. Leah — can you get SAML trace and SCIM timestamps?

leah: Asked ACME for SAML trace (base64 SAMLResponse) and Okta System Log entries; requested token value via secure channel so we can validate scopes.

maya: I'll prepare rollback-safe update: create new token with `scim:read,scim:write,users:manage` and rotate into POC tenant. If they won't paste token, they can use support UI to rotate.

sam: Security: rotating tokens needs audit entry + customer consent. Pre-approving for POC; enable audit logging for that tenant.

tom: If SCIM still 403 after scope fix, verify SCIM base URL. Dedicated expected: `https://scim.<tenant-host>/v2/Users`. If they used hosted endpoint by mistake, auth fails.

leah: ACME posted Okta logs and SCIM timestamp. Okta shows `400` earlier on ACS URL then `200` later but NameID is `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent`.

sam: Intermittent behavior explained. We need them to switch to `emailAddress`. We could map persistent->email on our side but it's a manual transform requiring product signoff; not ideal for POC.

leah: Customer prefers minimal changes. Can we do a quick transform in gateway for the POC to map persistent NameID to email?

maya: We can add a temporary shim in the POC gateway that detects NameID format `persistent` and looks up email via SCIM lookup. Best-effort; needs eng-runtime approval.

tom: I'll ping eng-runtime and tag @runtime-lead with sample SAMLResponse + logs.

onboarding-bot: POC-2293 updated — scope patch planned, shim requested, security approval pending.

leah: ACME asked for a Hosted API key to run quick smoke tests while we sort Dedicated. Can we issue a short-lived hosted key?

sam: OK to issue hosted short-lived key (12h), read-only, limited quotas. Logged and auditable — security approves for POC if expired and monitored.

leah: Sent hosted test key via secure channel and told them to use hosted for smoke tests until Dedicated token rotated.

maya: Created new token with `scim:read,scim:write,users:manage` and staged for rotation. Waiting ACME approval to swap.

leah: ACME approved rotation. Can we schedule 15m window to swap and watch provisioning?

tom: I can monitor logs. Let's do 14:00 PT. I'll be on call.

sam: I'll monitor audit logs and confirm scopes post-rotation.

maya: If SCIM still 403 after rotation, run this from customer network to confirm endpoint and token scopes:

maya: ```bash
curl -s -D - -X GET "https://scim.acme-poc.redwood.internal/v2/Users?filter=userName%20eq%20"jane.doe"" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
```

leah: Swap scheduled for 14:00 PT with 30m rollback window.

onboarding-bot: POC-2293 scheduled swap at 14:00 PT.

leah: Post-swap: rotation succeeded, initial SCIM sync 200, users provisioned. Some legacy users still hit SAML NameID mismatch; recommended ACME change NameID format for full fix. POC acceptable for demo.

tom: Closing blocker but follow-ups: PROD-safe NameID mapping, auto-scope migration for legacy tokens.

sam: Opening security ticket for temporary hosted key and audit notes.

maya: I'll run a migration job to auto-add `scim:write` to tokens created before role flag.

leah: Thanks team — ACME green for demo next week. :tada:
